_comment: Permissions and entitlements for spike 0b. Without these the recorder stops
the moment the screen locks, which is indistinguishable from the OEM
battery-manager failure the spike exists to detect — so getting them right
is what makes a FAIL trustworthy.
iOS: UIBackgroundModes.location is what keeps delivery going with the app
backgrounded; the two usage strings are shown in the permission dialogs and
App Review rejects vague ones, so they say what a tour recorder actually
Android: ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION is the 'Allow all the time' choice, and
FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION is mandatory from Android 14 for a location
foreground service. WAKE_LOCK keeps the service alive between fixes.
expo-location's config plugin adds most of these, but they are stated here
so the spike does not depend on a plugin's defaults for the one thing it

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Records your position while you plan or walk a tour.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Keeps recording your tour with the screen off and the phone in a pocket, so the track is complete when you get back.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Keeps recording your tour with the screen off and the phone in a pocket.
